summary: Segment 3 (Courier Dashboard + shared HeaderNav) frontend E2E testing passed 100%. All courier flows (pickup scan, manifest, angkut-semua, delivery list, POD cancel/confirm) work as specified. HeaderNav (nav-cashier, nav-production, nav-courier) is present and functional on all 3 routes with correct active highlighting. No regressions on Cashier/Production (back-button and goto-production-button correctly removed).
critical_code_review_comments: CourierDashboard.jsx is ~530 lines and fully self-contained; still under 700 threshold but if POD/Pickup modals grow, extract into PickupScannerModal and PoDModal subcomponents for maintainability.

handleScanPickup uses stale 'manifest.length' in the toast description (closure captures value at click time). Works today because state update is batched but prefer computing from functional setState result.
Minor: randomised mock scan IDs could collide with existing rows (e.g., LND-011); consider monotonic counter for clarity in testing. Currently non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 420x900 used. All 13 scenarios from review_request validated via Playwright on public URL. Verified: HeaderNav renders on /, /production, /courier with correct active pill highlight; active pill uses #FFD700 background. Courier initial state: 3 manifest bags (LND-011/012/013), pickup-sticky-bar shows 'ANGKUT SEMUA (3 BAGS)'. Scan pickup auto-closes after ~1.5s and prepends new bag (count went 3→4). ANGKUT SEMUA empties manifest, shows manifest-empty, and disables button at '(0 BAGS)'. Delivery tab shows 3 orders (LND-005/006/007); pickup-sticky-bar is hidden on delivery tab as required. POD cancel keeps LND-005; POD confirm (after ~900ms spinner → 'Foto tersimpan') removes LND-005 and count becomes 2. Old back-button and goto-production-button testids are gone — confirmed removed.
